intent: Add a passive kernel driver surface inventory plugin for Windows .sys and Linux .ko artifacts while preserving the three-tool gateway model and runtime opt-in boundary.

public_research_inputs: Linux module metadata and module signing documentation
Public driver surface analysis projects and research

steps.args: gap scan, implementation pattern scan, public research scan
kernel-driver-surface plugin, parser, SDK taxonomy, tests, docs
targeted Jest, TypeScript, build, docs generation, docker generation, lint, diff check
steps.artifacts: jest targeted suites; npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false; npm run build; npm run docs:tool-catalog; npm run docker:generate:all; npm run lint; git diff --check

steps.args: commit scoped files and open PR with gh
merge PR to beta if checks pass, deploy to server, run MCP smoke
